narrative_purpose: The chapter cover compresses its argument into one image: Pandora's immense forest depends on a hidden microbial world beneath a single fallen leaf.
subject: A single broad luminous alien leaf resting on damp black forest soil, its upper surface still glowing faint cyan while its torn lower edge dissolves into a dense miniature world of fine fungal threads, translucent microbial films, tiny mineral grains, and new root hairs. The visible forest above is only a dim suggestion; the intricate living soil below the leaf is the true focal subject.
scene: Pandora's forest floor at deep dusk immediately after rain, viewed close enough that a fallen leaf becomes a landscape.
camera: Low intimate macro hero view, leaf crossing the center diagonally, a shallow cutaway into the soil visible beneath its lower edge.
light: Soft bioluminescent cyan from the leaf and fine fungal threads, restrained teal reflections in water films, deep indigo ambient shadow, one scarce amber glint among mineral grains.
palette: Void-indigo soil and background, cyan and living teal biological glow, muted mineral grey, sparse ember-amber accent.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, luminous but scientifically observed.
detail_level: Crisp on the leaf edge, fungal filaments, root hairs and soil pores; the towering forest behind dissolves into dark haze.
composition: Leaf as the central diagonal bridge between the dim macro forest above and the bright microscopic architecture below, with generous dark negative space around it.
consistency_notes: Establish the recurring fallen-leaf motif. Cool Pandora palette, restrained natural bioluminescence, and a credible soil cutaway rather than fantasy sparkles.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no arrows, no infographic chrome, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon or anime style
